question: If wildlife sanctuaries are there to protect wild animals, then what do biosphere reserves protect?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Entire biodiversity of the area**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Biosphere reserves** are designated areas that aim to conserve the **entire biodiversity of the area**, which includes not only the flora and fauna but also the ecosystem as a whole.
 
• These reserves promote sustainable development and involve local communities in conservation efforts.
